answer: Because the timing is recorded against the plume challenge, the relic audit can replay the tundra history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 281 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 4255 identities would post 4949 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
